ios.desc:
Meet Miyu — your personal focus friend! Start a study timer, beat distractions, and stay on track with streaks, rewards, and a cute companion who works with you. All of that while having fun!

- Flexible Focus: Start from 10 minutes with no upper limit — enter your “sweet focus zone” without sudden timer cut-offs.
- Deep Focus: Block other apps, such as social media and games, while you are focusing together with Miyu.
- Customize Miyu: Customize the look and feel of the app with a variety of outfits, rooms, and colors. Make it feel at home for you and Miyu.
- Stay on Track Anywhere: Live Activity will keep you informed about your current session even if you minimize the app. But don’t leave for too long! Miyu will become sad if you do so :(
- Celebrate your progress: Streaks, reports, and achievements keep you motivated every day.
- Smart Reminders: Get reminders from Miyu herself to keep on track with your Streak and make little steps towards your goal every single day.
- Widgets: Track your streak and get motivation from Miyu right at your home screen.

With Miyu Pro, you gain access to:
- 5 premium outfits & 5 premium rooms
- Deep Focus mode, which blocks other apps such as Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook
- Streak freeze
- Extra coins for each focus session

In addition, you support independent development. Miyu is made by a single developer without support from big companies or VC funds.

Ready to turn your study sessions into a game? Download Miyu now — the focus companion that makes studying and working fun.

Still have questions or some feedback? Reach me at [gentle.dragon.help@gmail.com](mailto:gentle.dragon.help@gmail.com)

Privacy Policy: https://miyuapp.jp/privacy-policy/

Terms and Conditions: https://miyuapp.jp/terms-and-conditions/

Made with Love in Chiba Prefecture

quotes.text:
Hi everyone! My name is Roman, and I am an indie iOS developer.

I was inspired by Lo-Fi girl, and I liked to study with her, but the process always lacked some interactivity, and I wanted it to feel like I was actually studying with a friend. In addition, I thought that it would have been great to actually track my progress on how many hours I studied today.

That's how I came up with this app. It is a focus timer with a girl called Miyu that acts as a study buddy.

It is my first iOS app, so I would appreciate any feedback you have on how I can improve it. Thank you!
